en.headline: Police investigate alleged Mark Six prize dispute among FEHD staff
en.dek: A 36-year-old health inspector is wanted after colleagues reported that a shared winning ticket from last Saturday’s jackpot was not divided as agreed.
body: Police are investigating a reported theft linked to a Mark Six win involving staff of the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department. According to reports, about 15 colleagues in the market revitalisation team pooled money for last Saturday’s high-prize draw and a half-share of the first prize, worth more than HK$30 million, was credited to one account.

The 36-year-old health inspector who purchased the ticket is alleged to have refused to share the proceeds equally. After negotiations broke down earlier this week he stopped reporting for duty and colleagues reported the matter. Police have classified the case as theft and issued a wanted notice; Aberdeen Division is handling the inquiry.
The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department said it was aware of the police investigation and would cooperate as required, but declined further comment while inquiries continue.

zh.headline: 食環署職員夾份中六合彩 衛生督察疑拒平分被通緝
zh.dek: 據報15名活化街市組人員合資中半注頭獎逾三千萬元，負責買票的36歲衛生督察疑拒平分後失蹤，警方列盜竊通緝。
body: 警方正調查一宗涉及食環署職員的盜竊案。據了解，活化街市組約15名同事上周六合資投注六合彩金多寶，半注頭獎逾三千萬元撥入其中一人戶口。
負責購買彩票的36歲衛生督察其後據報拒絕平分獎金，與同事談判破裂後多日沒有上班。同事報警求助，警方將案件列作盜竊，由香港仔警區跟進，並通緝涉案男子。
食環署發言人表示，署方知悉警方正調查事件，會按需要配合，現階段不宜評論細節。
